# ABJ Kitchens and Bedrooms

> ABJ Kitchens and Bedrooms designs, makes and fits bespoke kitchens, fitted wardrobes, bedrooms, media walls and made-to-measure storage from its own workshop and showroom in Peterborough, UK. Free home design visit with a 3D design and an itemised quote, a 12-month guarantee on our work, and installation within about 80 miles of Peterborough.

Key facts (updated 12 Nov 2026):

- Trading name of AB Joinery Kitchens and Bedrooms Ltd, registered in England and Wales, company no. 11100736, incorporated in December 2017; the team has around 20 years of joinery and fitted-furniture experience
- 2,500+ bespoke projects completed
- Rated 4.9 out of 5 on Google from 100+ reviews
- Showroom and workshop: 3 Brassey Close, Peterborough, PE1 2AZ, United Kingdom
- Phone: 01733 686767 · WhatsApp: 07479 219421 · Email: info@abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk
- Opening hours: Monday to Friday 08:00 to 18:00, Saturday 10:00 to 14:00, Sunday closed. Call before travelling to the showroom.
- Everything is made to measure in our Peterborough workshop, with no standard-size units, and fitted by our own team
- Process: free design visit and measure, 3D design with an itemised quote, made in our workshop in about 4 to 6 weeks after design sign-off, then usually 1 to 2 weeks to fit a kitchen
- Price guide: a compact bespoke kitchen, made and fitted, starts from around £2,500; a typical medium kitchen with quartz worktops comes to around £7,000 to £9,500. The surveyor gives a rough idea at the visit; the exact price comes with the designer's quote.
- Guarantee: 12 months on our work. Longer manufacturer warranties can apply to some parts depending on what you choose.
- Finance: 12 months interest-free through Ideal4Finance on projects over £6,000 with a 50% deposit, subject to status. ABJ is an introducer appointed representative of Ideal Sales Solutions Ltd t/a Ideal4Finance, a credit broker (FRN 703401), not a lender.
- Hardware: GTV, Blum or Häfele hinges, runners and fittings, chosen to suit each project
- Supply-only kitchens are also available for customers who use their own fitter
- Service area: Peterborough and towns within about 80 miles, including Stamford, Oundle, Market Deeping, Bourne, Spalding, Oakham, Grantham, Huntingdon, St Ives, Ely, Wisbech, Cambridge, St Neots, Corby, Kettering, March, Whittlesey, Chatteris and King's Lynn

## Kitchens

- [Bespoke Kitchens](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/bespoke-kitchens): Handleless, Shaker, traditional and island kitchens made in our Peterborough workshop and fitted by our own team
- [Shaker and In-Frame Kitchens](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/shaker-kitchens-peterborough): Shaker and in-frame kitchens painted in any colour
- [Handleless Kitchens](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/handleless-kitchens-peterborough): True handleless kitchens with recessed rails, in matt or gloss
- [Kitchen Design](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/kitchen-design-peterborough): Free home design visit, 3D kitchen design and an itemised quote
- [Kitchen Cabinets and Units](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/kitchen-cabinets-peterborough): Made-to-measure, rigid cabinets with soft-close hinges and drawers
- [Supply-Only Kitchens](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/supply-only-kitchens-peterborough): Bespoke kitchens made in our workshop and supplied for you or your fitter to install
- [Worktops](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/luxury-worktops-abj): Quartz, granite, solid wood and compact laminate worktops supplied and fitted
- [Bespoke vs Off-the-Shelf Kitchens](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/bespoke-vs-off-the-shelf-kitchens): How they differ on fit, materials, price and lead time

## Wardrobes and Bedrooms

- [Fitted Wardrobes](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/bespoke-wardrobes): Sliding, hinged and walk-in wardrobes made to measure
- [Sliding Wardrobes](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/sliding-wardrobes): Mirror, glass, wood-effect or painted doors, including replacement doors for existing wardrobes
- [Walk-In Wardrobes](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/walk-in-wardrobes): Walk-in wardrobes and dressing rooms planned around your clothes
- [Wardrobes for Sloping Ceilings](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/fitted-wardrobes-sloping-ceilings): Wardrobes built to the angle of loft and eaves ceilings
- [Fitted Bedrooms](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/bespoke-bedrooms-abj): Wardrobes, bedside units, dressing tables and children's bedrooms
- [Bespoke Upholstery](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/upholstery): Headboards, cushions and reupholstery

## Living Spaces and Storage

- [Media Walls](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/media-walls): TV walls, TV units and cabinets, electric fires, lighting, hidden cables and home bars
- [Alcove Units](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/alcove-units): Alcove cupboards, shelving, bookcases, library walls and window seats
- [Bespoke Storage](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/bespoke-storage-solutions): Storage for awkward corners, alcoves and utility rooms
- [Under-Stairs Storage](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/under-stairs-storage): Pull-out drawers, shoe storage and coat cupboards cut to your staircase
- [Utility Rooms and Boot Rooms](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/utility-boot-rooms-peterborough): Laundry storage, boot benches and coat storage
- [Hallway Storage](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/bespoke-hallways): Hallway and entrance furniture
- [Home Offices](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/bespoke-office-renovations): Fitted desks, shelving and storage
- [Wall Panelling and Feature Walls](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/bespoke-decors-peterborough): Panelling for bedrooms, hallways and living rooms
- [Bathroom Cabinetry](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/bathroom-cabinetry): Vanity units and bathroom cabinets made to measure

## Trade and Commercial

- [Office Fit-Outs](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/office-fit-out-peterborough): Reception desks, meeting rooms, staff kitchens and office furniture
- [Cabinet Makers and Joinery](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/cabinet-makers-peterborough): Bespoke cabinet making and joinery in Peterborough
